name: Destruction in Deadmines
objectiveText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines , and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.   Explosives placed  ( 1 ) Extra-Destructive Explosives (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The Forge is the room where [npc=1763] spawns. You will have to run pretty close to the center, and then just plant the explosives there.

[b]Don't hearth out of the dungeon after the run is complete; [u]exit from the backdoor, and continue the quest at the back entrance[/u].[/b]

[s]P.S. No reward outside of XP/reputation, but look at the numbers: [b]4050 XP[/b] for this, and another [b]680[/b] when you just talk to the quest giver afterwards. Even the quest for VanCleef himself only grants [b]2600 XP[/b], so in my opinion, this chain is worth the dynamite expenditure.[/s] EDIT: XP seems to have been nerfed.
